title: Roadside Assistance and Stolen Recovery Services
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on roadside assistance interactions and explanations of stolen vehicle recovery coverage, with negative comments about handling in some cases and several fragments that only describe service details or contact events.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe poor roadside assistance handling and avoiding mention of roadside assistance during an issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments describe roadside assistance contact, a tow dispatch, and explanations or confusion about stolen vehicle recovery coverage without clear sentiment.

limitations: The topic combines two related but distinct subjects, roadside assistance and stolen vehicle recovery, so the sample does not support a single more specific conclusion.
Several fragments are purely descriptive service notes without enough context to determine customer sentiment.
